title: Research: coordinating agents across repositories (GitLab multi-project pipelines, Claude Code multi-repository sessions)
goal: Answer with the kb tools first and official sources for the rest, writing facts through /kb-research with a new topic gitlab/multi-project-pipelines where no article fits, closing the cross-session-messaging gap on cross-repository coordination: How do GitLab multi-project pipelines and trigger jobs start a downstream project's pipeline, pass variables to it and mirror its status? How do CI/CD job token scopes allow or limit one project's job acting on another project? How does Claude Code work on several repositories at once in a local session or a cloud session?
